name: PrintableTools Lab Upload Error Cheatsheet Mirror
purpose: GitHub Pages discovery mirror for common PDF, image, JPG, PNG, resume, and email attachment upload errors with direct free no-signup fixes.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 1MB
entries.problem: A job, school, email, or admin portal rejects a PDF by file size.
entries.response: Open the PDF compressor with the 1MB target, compress locally, then review readability before submitting.

entries.errorText: PDF must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A strict form, exam upload, or school portal requires a very small PDF.
entries.response: Use the strict 500KB PDF target and keep the original file in case the compressed copy loses detail.

entries.errorText: Image must be less than 2MB
entries.problem: A profile, marketplace, support, or application page rejects an image over 2MB.
entries.response: Use the image-to-KB compressor with a 2048KB custom target.

entries.errorText: Image must be under 500KB
entries.problem: A portal or ticket form requires an image below 500KB.
entries.response: Use the 500KB image target, then resize if a large phone photo still misses the limit.

entries.errorText: Photo must be under 100KB
entries.problem: A job, profile, school, or ID-style form rejects a photo by KB size.
entries.response: Use the 100KB image target and check that the face or document text remains clear.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 20KB
entries.problem: An exam, job, or application portal combines exact photo dimensions with a very small file cap.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 20KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A photo upload box validates both exact 200 x 230 pixel dimensions and a small KB limit.
entries.response: Resize to 200 x 230 pixels first, then compress toward 50KB if the resized output is still too large.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 200 x 230 px and under 100KB
entries.problem: A profile, exam, or application form requires 200 x 230 pixels with a 100KB cap.
entries.response: Create the exact 200 x 230 image, then use the 100KB image target only if needed.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 240 x 320 px and under 50KB
entries.problem: A portrait photo upload requires exact 240 x 320 pixels and rejects files above 50KB.
entries.response: Resize to 240 x 320 pixels first, then compress the exported photo toward 50KB.

entries.errorText: Photo must be 295 x 413 px and under 35KB

entries.errorText: Photo must be 413 x 531 px and under 50KB

entries.errorText: PDF not accepted, JPG required
entries.problem: A form accepts images but rejects a PDF upload.
entries.response: Convert PDF pages to JPG/PNG locally and upload the page image the destination expects.

entries.errorText: Resume PDF too large
entries.problem: A job application or recruiter portal rejects a resume PDF by size.
entries.response: Try the 1MB PDF target and confirm all resume text remains readable before applying.

entries.errorText: Email attachment too large
entries.problem: Gmail, Outlook, school email, or work mail rejects a document attachment.
entries.response: Compress PDFs toward 5MB or use the image-to-KB tool for photo attachments.

safeUseRules: Share only where the linked page directly answers a blocked-upload problem.
Do not claim guaranteed compression results; tell users to review output quality.
Do not ask for ad clicks, ad views, artificial engagement, or private file examples.
